responsibility: Implements the query type operation for normalization over supported normalizable values, short-circuiting alias-free inputs and otherwise delegating to the appropriate normalization query or local solver-based normalization path.
same_name_distinction: This `normalize.rs` does not implement normalization itself; it defines the normalization type-op wrapper (`Normalize<T>`/`Normalizable`) that chooses fast paths and delegates either to normalization queries or a local next-solver path, unlike the other normalization files that perform the folding work directly.
